description: This PHP class 'MigrationState' in the Drupal migrate_drupal module manages and determines the upgrade state of modules during migration, analyzing migration plugins and configuration files to assess whether modules are fully migrated or pending.

classes.name: MigrationState
classes.description: Manages and determines the migration upgrade state for Drupal modules, analyzing migration plugins and configuration files to identify completed or pending migrations.

methods.name: getUpgradeStates
methods.description: Returns the upgrade states for all enabled source modules based on version, source system data, and migrations.

methods.name: getMigrationStates
methods.description: Retrieves migration state information from *.migrate_drupal.yml files.

methods.name: buildUpgradeState
methods.description: Builds the upgrade state for each source module, analyzing migrations and declared states.

methods.name: buildDiscoveredDestinationsBySource
methods.description: Builds source and destination module information from discovered migration plugins.

methods.name: buildDeclaredStateBySource
methods.description: Builds declared migration states from configuration files.

methods.name: getSourceState
methods.description: Determines if a source module's migration is finished or not based on current data.

methods.name: getDestinationsForSource
methods.description: Returns the list of destination modules for a given source module and version.
